title: LagOff RC3
message: RC3 fixes settings migration, data paths, and updater file-lock issues. RC2 users should install this build manually once; future updates work from inside LagOff.
releaseNotes: Fixed updater file-lock errors during install
Fixed auto-update when exe name changes (RC2 to RC3)
Auth, plugins, backgrounds, and crash data use LocalAppData
Community profiles save to the correct folder
Updater records correct previous/new version after install
